```artifact
feature: Admin functionality for managing labs and chemists
  scenario: Admin can add a new Speciality
    given an empty system state
    when the Admin enters a new Speciality name and submits the form
    then the system should create the Speciality and display a confirmation message
    
  scenario: Admin can update doctor information
    given an existing doctor record
    when the Admin enters updated details for the doctor
    then the system should reflect the changes and display a confirmation message
    
  scenario: Admin maintains Specialities
    scenario outline:
      given a Speciality with no associated doctors
      when the Admin attempts to delete the Speciality
      then the system should prevent deletion and display an error message
      
    example:
      | Speciality Name          | Expected Outcome                  |
      | "Cardiology"            | Speciality deleted              |
      | "Neurology"             | Speciality deleted              |
      
  scenario: Admin maintains Specialities
    given a Speciality with associated doctors
    when the Admin attempts to delete the Speciality
    then the system should prevent deletion and display an error message
    
  scenario: Admin maintains Doctors
    scenario outline:
      given a Doctor associated with a Speciality
          | Input Doctor Details          | Expected Outcome                  |
          | Name: John Doe, Specialty: Cardiology | Successful association |
          | Name: Jane Smith, Specialty: Neurology | Successful association |
      
      when the Admin attempts to associate a Doctor with an invalid Speciality
      then the system should reject the association and display an error message
      
      when the Admin attempts to associate a Doctor with a Speciality without any existing doctors
      then the system should create the Speciality and associate the Doctor
      
      when the Admin attempts to disassociate a Doctor from a Speciality
      then the system should remove the association and display a confirmation message
```
